note: Emergency numbers for Labo, as published by the sources cited on each entry. Every number here was read from a named source on 2026-10-17; nothing is inferred. Where two official sources publish DIFFERENT numbers for the same station, both are listed and flagged rather than one being chosen. THE LGU'S OWN EMERGENCY DIRECTORY IS PARTLY UNFILLED: labo.gov.ph/contact-us/ shows the placeholder '0912 345 6789' for BOTH the Labo District Hospital and the PNP, and '091234567890' under General Inquiries - those dummy values are recorded here as a defect, never as numbers to dial.

entries.note: Published by the LGU itself and repeated on its tourism page. The two that are solidly verified and locally specific.

entries.note: Labo's area code is (054). The officials page repeats this same value for all 28 offices, so it is a building switchboard, not a direct line per office.

entries.note: Reproduced exactly as the DOH facility registry prints it. The digit grouping looks malformed - verify by dialling before relying on it.
From a provincial listing reproduced by an LGU tourism page. No hospital-, DOH- or LGU-issued publication of this number was found, and other directories contradict each other.
117 is the emergency line; 0917-847-5757 is the text hotline.

defects.what: The LGU's emergency directory lists placeholder numbers
defects.detail: labo.gov.ph/contact-us/ shows '0912 345 6789' for BOTH 'Labo District Hospital' and 'Philippine National Police', and '091234567890' and '+619 8321' under 'General Information and Inquiries'. Of the five entries in its EMERGENCY block, only three carry real values (MDRRMO, BFP-Labo, and a radio station). Anyone who dials the hospital or police row from the municipality's own page reaches nothing.

defects.what: Two official sources disagree on the Labo fire station's hotline
defects.detail: The LGU publishes 0949 812 3708 / 585 2018; the fire station's own Facebook page publishes 0920-986-1451.
